decisions.reason: The exact ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 model was already established when the GPIO assignments were resolved; adding its LCSC part number does not change those assignments.
Confirming the LCSC part number for the already-selected controller module does not change the panel connector inventory, signals, or button-placement policy.
The module part-number confirmation does not change the established BOOT or reset controls or their 1uF capacitance values.
The standalone USB supply already targets the selected ESP32-S3 module, and its regulator, rail, activation, and source-selection behavior remain unchanged.
Adding a sourcing identifier for the existing ESP32-S3 module does not alter the DCDC1 rail voltage, current rating, or powered-load role.
The 5V boost enable mapping had already been changed to GPIO5 for module compatibility; the later LCSC part-number confirmation introduces no further change.
The source confirms a controller-module part number and has no effect on the battery connector family, part number, pin count, functions, or unresolved pin order.
This Requirement concerns readiness of the power-board BOM, including capacitor LCSC numbers and component justification; confirming the main controller module does not necessarily change that state.
The exact module model was already known when the I2C topology was established, so its LCSC identifier does not change cable, pull-up, or series-resistor requirements.
Confirming the sourcing identifier for the existing ESP32-S3 module does not alter the USB data lines or programming-port role.
The controller module part-number confirmation does not change the selected LED, data GPIO, power source, standby control, or level-shifting requirement.
The LCSC number confirmed by the source identifies the ESP32 module, not the independently selected USB-C connector, so the connector selection and sourceability state remain unchanged.
